definitions.explanation: A document summarizing one's personal information, education, and work history for job applications.

examples.english: I wrote a resume and sent it.

notes:
{履歴書|りれきしょ} is a compound: ⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧ (personal history) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document).

JAPANESE RESUME FORMAT:
Japanese {履歴書|りれきしょ} follows a standardized format (JIS⟦{規格|きかく}→規格：16939_kikaku⟧) that includes:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (photo - required)
- ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧ (educational background)
- ⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧ (work history)
- ⟦{志望動機|しぼうどうき}→志望動機：18865_shiboudouki⟧ (reason for applying)
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧・⟦{特技|とくぎ}→特技：09350_tokugi⟧ (hobbies/special skills)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a resume)
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send a resume)
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a resume)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese resumes are handwritten, as handwriting is thought to reveal personality. However, typed resumes are becoming more acceptable, especially in modern industries.
